title: Card strip step-slide into scattered orbit
summary: A row of full-bleed image cards steps sideways one card at a time on light grey, punches in once, then hard-cuts to the same five cards scattered in a ring that turns one revolution with a colour-fringe edge.
use_when: Showing 4 to 6 portfolio images, posters or product shots without any copy
A vertical social teaser for a template, design or merch drop
A gallery beat inside a longer film where the visuals carry the message
Silent autoplay where motion alone must hold attention

look.type_style: no type of its own; all text lives inside the images

sfx.event: hard cut to the scattered ring

structure.shot: horizontal strip of tall image cards, edge to edge, band ~47 % H centred on flat grey; product card left, poster right
structure.camera: strip slides right ~1 card width (about 220 then 400 px/s @1920), scale 1.00 -> 1.06
structure.motion: strip steps right by one card, springs.ui ~20 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s), step lands 1.50; third card enters from the left edge

structure.shot: three cards visible: new dark card left, product card centre, poster clipped at the right edge
strip steps right again; the dark card reaches centre and a bright blue-yellow poster card enters from the left
structure.motion: one-card step, springs.ui ~22 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); settles 3.77

structure.shot: same three cards, the strip grows: band height 47 % -> 61 % H, cards now overflow both edges
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.27 over ~24 fr (26 %/s), slight drift down 76 px/s
structure.motion: springs.cameraIn ~24 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); scale holds at 1.27 to the cut

structure.shot: strip reverses and steps left twice: dark card exits left, product card passes centre, poster card lands right of centre
structure.camera: pan left ~710 then ~510 px/s @1920 at scale 1.27
structure.motion: two one-card steps, springs.ui ~18 fr each (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s), second step lands 6.27

structure.shot: hold: product card left half, poster card right half, strip at scale 1.27
structure.motion: hold 47 fr, no motion; cut at f257

structure.shot: same five images as small cards (~30-40 % W each) scattered on a ring around the empty centre on grey; cards bend slightly like curled paper, colour-fringed edges
structure.motion: cards sway in place, curl changes a few degrees, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the ring of five cards turns one full revolution around the frame centre; each card keeps facing camera with perspective tilt toward the edge
structure.camera: static frame; ring rotation peaks ~1500 px/s @1920 at 12.5
structure.motion: ring revolution 360 deg over 150 fr, easings.inOutSine; cards near the edges foreshorten and clip at the frame edge

structure.shot: ring settles back to its starting arrangement and holds
structure.motion: final settle ~15 fr springs.ui (±0.25 s), then hold 49 fr; card sway continues lightly

params.images: 5 image cards (portrait ~3:5 in the strip); the same list feeds the strip and the ring
params.strip.steps: list of strip offsets in card widths with frame times; default +1 at f30, +1 at f105, push 1.27 at f120, -1 at f150, -1 at f180
params.strip.bandHeight: card band height as share of H before the push (default 0.47)
params.cutAt: frame of the hard cut to the ring (default 257)
params.ring.radius: ring radius as share of W (default 0.36)
params.ring.revolutionFrames: frames for the full revolution (default 150, starts f300)
params.fringe: RGB split amount on the ring cards in px (default 3, 0 = off)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and motion.json. Strip cards touch edge to edge with small radii; band 47 % H, then 61 % H after the push at 4.0-5.0 s and it never scales back. Steps are one card width each and alternate direction: right, right, push, left, left. Shot 2 shows all five images as curled cards on a ring with a persistent RGB fringe (Proposed terms: card-curl, chroma-fringe; not vocabulary ids). Ring returns to its start pose, so shot 2 alone loops. No audio in the reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
